data.one_liner: Tool to remove all print() and debugPrint() statements from Dart files
data.what_it_does: It scans Dart files, deletes print() and debugPrint() calls, supports dry‑run, verbose output, and custom paths.
use_when: Removing debug logs from production builds
avoid_when: When you need to keep logs for debugging
When you prefer manual review of changes
strengths: Supports nested calls and comment‑aware removal
weaknesses: Only removes print/debugPrint, not other logging
No integration with build systems out of the box
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and run `dart pub get`
